CMD=$(jq -r '.tool_input.command // empty');CTX='';if printf '%s
' "$CMD" | grep -qE '(^|[;&|][[:space:]]*)([A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*=[^[:space:]]*[[:space:]]+)*(env[[:space:]]+([A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*=[^[:space:]]*[[:space:]]+)*)?gh pr create' && ! printf '%s
' "$CMD" | grep -qE '(^|[[:space:]])--help([[:space:]]|$)'; then CTX='A PR was just created. Project rule: run /codex-review (cross-vendor Codex review of this branch) now, triage its findings, and record the verdict in the PR before handing it over for merge.'; fi;if printf '%s
' "$CMD" | grep -qE '(^|[;&|][[:space:]]*)git push'; then CTX="$CTX${CTX:+ }A git push just ran. Before treating this work as done: check the CI result for the pushed commit (gh run watch --exit-status <run-id>, or gh pr checks <pr> --watch) and report the outcome. If CI is red, investigate and fix before moving on."; elif printf '%s

hooks.command:
CMD=$(jq -r '.tool_input.command // empty'); printf '%s' "$CMD" | grep -qE '(^|[^a-zA-Z0-9_-])git([^a-zA-Z0-9_-]|$)' || exit 0; printf '%s' "$CMD" | grep -qE '(^|[^a-zA-Z0-9_-])commit([^a-zA-Z0-9_-]|$)' || exit 0; TAIL="${CMD#*commit}"; MSG=$(printf '%s' "$TAIL" | sed -n 's/.*--*m\(essage\)*[[:space:]=]*"\([^"]*\).*/\2/p'); [ -n "$MSG" ] || MSG=$(printf '%s' "$TAIL" | sed -n "s/.*--*m\(essage\)*[[:space:]=]*'\([^']*\).*/\2/p"); case "$MSG" in *'[red]'*) exit 0 ;; esac; BARE=$(printf '%s' "$TAIL" | sed "s/'[^']*'//g; s/"[^"]*"//g"); DIR="${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null)}"; [ -n "$DIR" ] || { echo 'Commit gate cannot locate the repository (CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR unset and not inside a work tree) — blocking rather than passing unchecked.' >&2; exit 2; }; ENG="$DIR/Packages/EmbroideryEngine"; if [ -d "$ENG" ]; then OUT=$(cd "$ENG" && swift test 2>&1) || { echo 'Engine tests are red — commit blocked. Never commit failing engine tests (fix or finish the green phase first). A deliberate TDD red-phase commit is allowed with a [red] marker in the commit message.' >&2; echo "$OUT" | tail -30 >&2; exit 2; }; fi; PROJ="$DIR/catrobat_embroidery_ios/catrobat_embroidery_ios.xcodeproj"; APP=0; git -C "$DIR" diff --cached --name-only | grep -q '^catrobat_embroidery_ios/' && APP=1; if [ "$APP" -eq 0 ] && printf '%s' "$BARE" | grep -qE '(^|[[:space:]])(--all|--include|--only|--)([[:space:]]|$)|(^|[[:space:]])-[a-zA-Z]*[ai][a-zA-Z]*([[:space:]]|$)'; then git -C "$DIR" diff --name-only | grep -q '^catrobat_embroidery_ios/' && APP=1; fi; if [ -d "$PROJ" ] && [ "$APP" -eq 1 ]; then command -v xcodebuild >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo 'Staged changes touch catrobat_embroidery_ios/ but xcodebuild is not on PATH, so the app cannot be compile-checked — blocking rather than passing unchecked (ADR-023). Install Xcode and its command line tools, or mark a deliberate red-phase commit with [red] in the message.' >&2; exit 2; }; DD="$HOME/Library/Caches/catty-embroidery-precommit-$(printf '%s' "$DIR" | cksum | cut -d' ' -f1)"; OUT=$(xcodebuild build-for-testing -project "$PROJ" -scheme catrobat_embroidery_ios -destination 'generic/platform=iOS' -derivedDataPath "$DD" CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO -quiet 2>&1) || { echo 'App target does not compile — commit blocked. Signing-free generic-device build, no simulator boot; it compiles the app and test targets only, so a test that compiles but fails is still CI'"'"'s to catch. A deliberate TDD red-phase commit is allowed with a [red] marker.' >&2; ERRS=$(printf '%s
' "$OUT" | grep -E 'error:' | head -20); [ -n "$ERRS" ] || ERRS=$(printf '%s
' "$OUT" | tail -20); printf '%s
' "$ERRS" >&2; exit 2; }; fi
hooks.statusMessage: engine test + app compile gate (git commit)
